heading_script_line: The Outdoors Is Part of the Classroom.
body_text: Outdoor free play lets children decide what to play, with whom and how, building confidence, coordination and independence.

items.title: Nature Walks & Gardening
items.text: Children notice the world, care for it and ask questions.

items.title: Water & Mud Play
items.text: Sensory exploration with natural materials and room for experiments.

items.title: Curiosity in Action
items.text: “What makes a seed grow?” leads children to plant, watch, measure, draw and talk about what plants need.
